title: Update the four documents naming the route class, and write D2's migration note
action: Turn psa-2's red test green. Add perf to all four source sites: skills/bee-hive/references/scout-and-ticks.md:34, docs/product-description/goal.md:48, docs/product-description/lifecycle/planning.md:35, and docs/product-description/verification/lifecycle.md:114 (that last one is an executable verification row, so keep its run/expect wording coherent). Then write the migration note D2 requires — flatly, not conditionally: D2 states the enum change 'is a public-contract change and carries a migration note'. The note records what a host repo pinning an older bee sees when it meets class: perf. The answer is already established: validation runs on --set only (workflows.rs:268 — '--show is a pure read'), so an older bee prints an unknown class and never validates it. Put the note where this repo keeps contract-change notes; if no such home exists, say so in the cap and put it in docs/history/pstack-adoption/. Run `bee dev regen` after touching skills/**.
